description: This Java class provides services for preparing and sending email notifications within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for generating email bodies from templates, setting base URLs for links, and dispatching emails via the 'sendMail' service.

classes.name: NotificationServices
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to prepare and send email notifications using templates, with support for dynamic URL generation and template processing.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Generates email body from template if not provided and sends email via 'sendMail' service.

methods.name: prepareNotification
methods.description: Processes a template with provided data to generate the email message body.

methods.name: setBaseUrl
methods.description: Sets the 'baseUrl' and 'baseSecureUrl' in the context for link generation, using system configuration or hostname resolution.
